app.title: ISponsorBlockTV: SponsorBlock client for all YouTube TV clients
app.description: Command‑line client that queries SponsorBlock API and inserts skip markers into YouTube TV playlists, enabling ad‑skipping on all TV clients.
proposed_tests: Run `isponsorblocktv --help` to ensure CLI parses options
Create a mock YouTube TV playlist file and run the tool to insert skip markers
Verify that the output playlist matches expected JSON format
